Money accepted because the government authorises it:
e: Money accepted because the government authorises it — fiat money (legal tender).

q: The regulator of formal sources of credit in India:
e: The regulator of formal sources of credit in India — Reserve Bank of India.

q: A demand deposit can be withdrawn:
o: terms of employment are regular and registered
e: A demand deposit can be withdrawn — on demand.

q: Public Distribution System shops are also called:
o: terms of employment are regular and registered
e: Public Distribution System shops are also called — ration shops (fair price shops).

q: The sector that includes agriculture and mining:
o: land, labour, physical capital and human capital
e: The sector that includes agriculture and mining — primary sector.

q: A company that owns or controls production in more than one country:
e: A company that owns or controls production in more than one country — multinational corporation (MNC).

q: Rapid integration of countries through trade and investment:
e: Rapid integration of countries through trade and investment — globalisation.

q: The poverty line is based on:
o: minimum level of food and other needs
e: The poverty line is based on — minimum level of food and other needs.

q: The average income of a country:
e: The average income of a country — per capita income.

q: Work where more people are employed than needed:
e: Work where more people are employed than needed — disguised unemployment.

q: A measure combining income, health and education:
e: A measure combining income, health and education — Human Development Index (HDI).

q: The Act passed in 1986 to protect consumers:
e: The Act passed in 1986 to protect consumers — Consumer Protection Act (COPRA).

q: The organisation that publishes the Human Development Report:
e: The organisation that publishes the Human Development Report — UNDP.
